scaled_confounded_cmdp.description: Tracked scaled CMDP reproduction target preserving the paper's hidden-confounder off-policy learning setup.
scaled_confounded_cmdp.notes: The paper reports masked-Atari returns. This gym uses an explicitly documented scaled CMDP with analytic target values because the full Atari demonstrator pipeline was not released and exceeds the available reproduction budget.

mean_return.description: Average interventional return of the saved policy in the confounded CMDP.

tail_return_10pct.description: Mean of the lowest-return decile, catching policies that improve the mean by accepting hidden-confounder downside.

safe_action_rate.description: Fraction of executed actions choosing the safe intervention.

risky_action_rate.description: Fraction of executed actions choosing the confounded risky intervention.

explicit_safe_state_rate.description: Fraction of CMDP states explicitly mapped to the safe action, preventing omitted states from looking safe by default.

valid_action_rate.description: Fraction of explicit policy entries using a legal action ID.

covered_states.description: Fraction of CMDP states explicitly covered by the saved policy artifact.

std_return.description: Episode-return standard deviation, penalizing unnecessary stochastic downside.

weaker_bias_cmdp.description: Additional scaled CMDP setting with weaker but still harmful hidden confounding under the same off-policy demonstrator protocol.
weaker_bias_cmdp.notes: The paper reports masked-Atari returns. This additional setting is a scaled robustness check for this gym and uses analytic target values rather than paper-reported Atari numbers.

mean_return.description: Average interventional return under weaker but still harmful hidden confounding.

tail_return_10pct.description: Mean of the lowest-return decile, catching residual risky-action exposure under the weaker-bias setting.
